site.title: The Unsorted Life
site.tagline: Single mom, veteran, probably autistic. My house is a mess and I'm finally doing something about it. Real products, real chaos, no performance.
site.disclosure: As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases. Every link below is an Amazon affiliate link. Everything here is something I own and use, and I say so when it didn't work.
site.start_here_intro: If you only look at four things: the crate that is still standing, the snack she would order herself, the pumpkin butter that ended begging at dinner, and the mop that made the kitchen floor a ten-minute job.

sections.title: Puppy
sections.intro: Six months in. What survived, what she eats, and what keeps her calm.

lists.title: What survived the puppy
lists.intro: Still standing, plus the one that isn't.

items.name: MidWest iCrate 36 inch folding crate with divider
items.note: Still standing, still where she sleeps. The divider came out at four months.

items.name: APPKER self warming crate mat
items.note: Close to indestructible, so I never worried about her chewing up a bed. It is firm, though. I put a folded towel on top for padding and moved her to something softer once she stopped chewing.

items.name: IRIS 50 lb dog food container with wheels and scoop
items.note: Fifty pounds of kibble, one latch, zero break-ins.

items.name: JOEJOY dog car booster seat
items.note: Still in use. She is too big to ride zipped in now, so it is unzipped and I need a new seatbelt for her. It was great in the shopping cart too; I did not want her feet on the cart grate. Mine was black; pick whichever color is in stock.
items.photo: Home Depot pup in her car seat 2.HEIC

items.name: Flying Pawfect long-pin slicker brush
items.note: Used daily, which is why the groomer said her temperament was amazing.

items.name: Snuggle Puppy heartbeat toy
items.note: The first night home. It worked.

items.name: Puppy play gym with snuffle mat
items.note: Still in use at six months.
items.photo: Puppy pen jungle gym and bowl stand.HEIC

items.name: Jovrun elevated adjustable stainless bowls
items.note: The feeding corner. Elevated beat the flat ones for her.
items.photo: Puppy pen jungle gym and bowl stand.HEIC

items.name: Foldable metal dog playpen
items.note: Honest one: it worked until she turned four months and learned to climb it. Buy the tall version.
items.photo: Puppy pen jungle gym and bowl stand.HEIC

lists.title: Treats and chews
lists.intro: What she actually works for, and what buys me twenty quiet minutes.

items.name: Pupford freeze-dried beef liver training treats
items.note: The ones she will actually work for. Tricks for treats happens because of these.

items.name: Himalayan yak cheese chews, small
items.note: Lasts longer than anything else on this list.

items.name: Mighty Paw bully sticks, 6 inch
items.note: For the evenings when I need twenty quiet minutes.

items.name: Blue Buffalo Bene Bars
items.note: Probably her favorite snack. If she could order her own, this is what would show up.

items.name: Harvest Moon hide-free puffed peanut butter strips
items.note: Not on Amazon as far as I can find; photo kept for the shorts.

items.name: Woof LickWells pumpkin butter
items.note: Another crowd pleaser. This is what kept her busy while we ate dinner, so she learned not to beg and did not have to be crated during meals.

items.name: Purina Beggin' Strips, bacon and cheese
items.note: Honest one: she loved them, her stomach did not. We stopped. Yours may be fine with them.

items.name: Natur Pet collagen stick
items.note: A long chew for the evenings.

items.name: Blue Buffalo Baby Blue training treats
items.note: She loved these. I used them sparingly, though; the freeze-dried liver treats let me give more during training without overdoing it.

lists.title: Calm, clean and cared for
lists.intro: The calming bites, the stain spray, the no-bath-day foam.

items.name: Nature's Miracle Advanced stain and odor eliminator
items.note: Works great. Carpet, toys, towels, and the mattress the night she peed on the bed. The bottle is almost empty, which is the review.

items.name: Mighty Mutt waterless dry shampoo foam
items.note: For the no-bath days, which is most days.

items.name: Snuggle Puppy Night Calm puppy bites
items.note: The ones recommended for crate training at night. I used them by the book because I wanted the crate to work and I wanted to sleep. Both happened.

items.name: Zesty Paws Advanced Calming Bites
items.note: For when the weather winds her up. Honestly not used much; the bag is still mostly full.

items.name: Kradle Calming Bliss Bar
items.note: For the times she was home alone longer than a quick store run, so she wasn't stressed. Only then.

sections.title: Home organization
sections.intro: Real rooms, open bins, no before-and-after theater.

lists.title: Cleaning that actually works
lists.intro: The sprays, wipes and machines I re-buy, plus the one that only half worked.

items.name: Bissell CrossWave wet dry vacuum mop
items.note: Vacuums and mops in one pass. Kitchen floor in ten minutes, then the stool barricade goes up.

items.name: Dawn Powerwash spray
items.note: The one cleaning spray I actually re-buy. Tub, sink, air vents, the ring on the shampoo bottle.

items.name: Swiffer heavy duty dusters with extendable pole
items.note: How the air vents got done without a ladder.

items.name: Swiffer duster starter kit
items.note: The regular ones, for everything at arm height.

items.name: Libman dust mop with washable microfiber head
items.note: The dust grabbers on the cloth are the point. Washable, so it keeps going.

items.name: Lysol dual action wipes
items.note: Scrub side for the vent grates.

items.name: Mold gel for grout and caulk
items.note: Honest one: works on grout if you leave it until it dries. Did nothing for my stained silicone caulk.

items.name: Clorox disinfecting wipes
items.note: The everyday wipes. Lysol for the dual-action scrub side, Clorox for everything else.

lists.title: Kitchen and pantry
lists.intro: Open baskets, no lids. That's the whole system.

items.name: White metal wire pantry baskets, 6 pack
items.note: Mine are discontinued; these are the closest match. One basket per category, throw it in, shut the door.

items.name: Wildone airtight cereal and flour containers
items.note: The one exception to the no-lids rule, so flour doesn't end up on everything.

items.name: Duck peel and stick shelf laminate
items.note: Lining the new kitchen drawers. Mine is the light taupe one.

lists.title: Bathroom storage
lists.intro: Fixed shelves, no drawers, one 7 year old.

items.name: Ageminglife wicker baskets with liners, 3 pack
items.note: Pull the whole basket out instead of digging.

items.name: Wood 3-compartment organizer with dividers
items.note: For the small things that used to roll around. Similar to mine.

items.name: Clear bins with bamboo lids, 4 pack
items.note: For what I need to see without opening.

items.name: Kids mouthwash
items.note: My kid is particular about flavors; bubblegum and watermelon are about the only ones that pass. This one passed.
items.photo: Sensory kid loved evereden product line_a.HEIC

items.name: Mouthwash dispenser with cups
items.note: Honest one: the lid lifts off around the top and it is not obvious, so it has been picked up by the lid and dropped, mouthwash everywhere, more than once. Works fine if you know that.
items.photo: Sensory kid loved evereden product line_a.HEIC

items.name: Evereden kids deodorant
items.note: She picked this one herself. She didn't even realize it was the same brand as her face wash and moisturizer.
items.photo: Sensory kid loved evereden product line_a.HEIC

items.name: Evereden kids face wash and moisturizer
items.note: The face wash and moisturizer she already used before the deodorant turned out to match.
items.photo: Sensory kid loved evereden product line_a.HEIC

lists.title: Closet and laundry
lists.intro: The guest bed is not a closet anymore.

items.name: Whitmor adjustable rolling garment rack
items.note: Hangables go straight from the dryer to the rack. No folding step to skip.

items.name: Amazon Basics slim velvet hangers, 100 pack
items.note: Every hanger the same. It took an hour and I can see what I own.

items.name: HOUSE DAY kids velvet hangers, pink
items.note: Her closet got the same treatment. She was never going to use black ones.

lists.title: Kid room reality
lists.intro: Cleanup is throwing, and a 7 year old will throw.

items.name: HOOBRO 3-bin toy storage cubby
items.note: The top ten stuffed animals live here. I screwed a bookshelf to the top of it.

items.name: Giantex 6-cube bookcase
items.note: The bookshelf on top of the bin. Comes with an anti-tip kit; use it.

items.name: LONCHDAN over-the-door stuffed animal organizer
items.note: The keepers that didn't make the bin. She can see them, I can't trip on them.
items.photo: New house bedroom over door storage.HEIC

lists.title: The move
lists.intro: Casualty number one was the mattress.

items.name: NapQueen 8 inch queen memory foam mattress, bed in a box
items.note: The replacement after the movers crushed the old one. No dip so far; I'll update this after a month.

lists.title: Garage and yard
lists.intro: Florida yard, one adult, no landscaper.

items.name: Ryobi 1800 PSI electric pressure washer
items.note: Mine is the 1600 PSI version; they only sell the 1800 now, which is fine. Actually shocked at how well it works for a plug-in one.

items.name: Sun Joe corded electric leaf blower
items.note: Corded, light, and it just works. The other thing from the garage I did not expect to be this good.

items.name: Stanley 3 gallon wet dry shop vac
items.note: Small enough to live in a closet, strong enough for the vents and the car.

items.name: Pet and kid safe weed killer
items.note: Works great. Too great: one or two leaves of overspray turned a baby flower bush half brown. Aim carefully.

sections.title: Gift lists
sections.intro: Wishes, not reviews. Only things I'd actually buy.

items.name: Umite Chef 21-piece nonstick pots and pans
items.note: Mine are scratched past saving. A full set, start over.

items.name: Dreame A3 AWD robot lawn mower
items.note: The dream. One less Saturday chore in Florida heat.

items.name: TAO Clean sonic toothbrush with UV cleaning station
items.note: The base cleans the brush head. Less counter clutter, less gross.

items.name: Sleek Socket flat plug extension
items.note: Lets furniture sit flush against the wall. Tiny thing, big difference.

items.name: Grüns superfood gummies for kids
items.note: On my list because I am the one who buys the vitamins she will actually eat.

lists.title: What's on my 7 year old's list

items.name: Roller skate sneakers with rechargeable wheels
items.note: Top of her list. The wheels light up and tuck away, which is the whole appeal.

items.name: Atari 2600+ PAC-MAN edition
items.note: Her idea, not mine. I am not mad about it.

items.name: Unicorn hooded robe
items.note: Hood with a horn. She will wear it to breakfast for a month.

items.name: Squishy making kit
items.note: So she can make her own instead of asking me for more.

items.name: Kids pottery wheel
items.note: Messy craft, but the kind that keeps her busy for an hour.

items.name: Tovla Jr. kid-safe knife set
items.note: She wants to help cook. These let her without me hovering.

items.name: Glow-in-the-dark unicorn cooling blanket
items.note: Hot sleeper who also wants glow stars. This does both.

items.name: Jumbo slow-rising squishies, 9 pack
items.note: Sensory kid, squishy phase. These are the big soft ones.

items.name: Strawberry, peanut and cheese squishy box
items.note: The small squeeze ones she keeps in her pocket.

items.name: Silicone slow-rising squishy set
items.note: Washable, which matters more than you would think.

items.name: Weaving loom kit
items.note: Quiet-time craft. Good for the after-school crash.

items.name: Glow-in-the-dark rock painting kit
items.note: Rocks, paint, glow. Easy win.

items.name: National Geographic glow rock painting kit
items.note: The other rock kit on her list. One of the two is getting wrapped.

items.name: Girls engineering science kit
items.note: 100 plus little builds. For the kid who takes things apart.

items.name: Skillmatics Sentence Search game
items.note: Stocking stuffer that sneaks in reading practice.

items.name: NoCry kids cutting gloves
items.note: Go with the knife set. Non-negotiable for me.

items.name: Kids bath bombs with surprises inside, 20 pack
items.note: Bath time is a negotiation. Surprise inside ends it.

items.name: All Clean glitter balm stick
items.note: Her big-girl request. Washes off, which is why it made the cut.

items.name: My First Mom and Daughter Journal
items.note: For us. Something to do together that is not a screen.

items.name: All the Animals, how to draw book
items.note: She draws on everything anyway. Might as well be a book.

items.name: Junie B. Jones first boxed set
items.note: Chapter books she can read to me instead of the other way around.

items.name: Disney Descendants: Wicked Wonderland junior novel
items.note: Current obsession. Reading is reading.

items.name: Heart-embroidered baggy wide-leg jeans
items.note: Pull-on waist. No buttons means no bathroom emergencies.

items.name: Flare jeans with bow detail
items.note: Her pick. Elastic waist, so my pick too.

items.name: Guess wide-leg stretch jeans
items.note: The nice pair for pictures and grandparents.

items.name: Pink and black cat gaming chair
items.note: The big-ticket ask. Ears on the headrest.

lists.title: For the person who has everything
For the mom who deserves the world
lists.intro: A gift guide, not a review. These are the things on my own wish list for the moms in my life.

items.name: Kendra Scott Lee drop earrings
items.note: The safe splurge. She has seen them on someone and said nothing.

items.name: Salt & Stone body mist discovery set
items.note: Four minis so she picks the scent, not you.

items.name: Oura Ring 5
items.note: The big one. For the mom who tracks everyone's sleep but her own.

items.name: Boll & Branch organic waffle robe
items.note: The nice robe she will never buy herself. That is the whole point.

items.name: Heated faux fur throw
items.note: Couch, book, heated blanket. She will disappear for an hour.

items.name: Mom's Story memory and keepsake journal
items.note: Prompts she answers, a book her kids keep. Costs less than flowers.

items.name: Kendra Scott Elton cuff bracelet
items.note: Goes with the earrings or on its own. Comes in the box she will keep.

items.name: Salt & Stone coconut and soy candle
items.note: For the mom who lights candles she was saving for company.

items.name: Summer Fridays Jet Lag essentials set
items.note: Skincare minis that fit in the bag she already carries.

items.name: Hatch Restore 3 sunrise alarm
items.note: A gentler wake-up than a phone on the nightstand.

items.name: Fluffy plush hooded robe
items.note: The cozy version, for the mom who runs cold.

items.name: Nekteck shiatsu foot massager with heat
items.note: For feet that have been standing since 6 am.

items.name: Hunter insulated short rain boots
items.note: Practical and pretty. Rare combination.

items.name: Skylight Calendar 2 touchscreen
items.note: The family calendar on the wall instead of in her head.

items.name: harriet stovetop tea kettle
items.note: Pretty enough to live on the stove. For the tea mom.
